title: San Diego this weekend … hope to see you!
excerpt: I’ll be speaking for the Episcopal Diocese of San Diego this weekend … On Sunday, I’ll be at St. Paul’s Cathedral, speaking at the Contemplative Service at 8:00 a.m., then at the Adult Forum at 9:00 a.m., and then at the Choral Mass at 10:30 a.m. You’re welcome to any of these…
body: I’ll be speaking for the Episcopal Diocese of San Diego this weekend … On Sunday, I’ll be at St. Paul’s Cathedral, speaking at the Contemplative Service at 8:00 a.m., then at the Adult Forum at 9:00 a.m., and then at the Choral Mass at 10:30 a.m. You’re welcome to any of these services. Hope to see you there!
